nodes.statement:
The receptor-level realization reproduces the baseline recruitment claim:
across 5 seeds the final recruitment index is 0.5667 (95% CI
0.3451-0.7882), above the 0.5 pass threshold, with responder activation
gated by a per-cell Hill-occupancy receptor model calibrated to a cited
CXCL8-CXCR1 Kd rather than an arbitrary chemotaxis strength.

nodes.statement:
The intervention works in the receptor-level realization too: across 5
seeds the final recruitment index is 0.0667 (95% CI 0.0-0.1467) with
the activated-type chemotaxis lambda forced to 0, versus 0.5667 for the
receptor baseline -- recruitment remains response-dependent even when
receptor binding itself is unaffected.
